svg.title: Ocean
svg.desc: Windows and tiled groups sit on a larger dotted canvas. A bright frame marks what one monitor shows; arrows and zoom buttons show pan and zoom.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Adwaita Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: One endless canvas. Pan and zoom the camera.
